caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a standing human figure, positioned on a rectangular dark gray pedestal base. The figure has brown skin and long black hair, and is dressed in a knee-length red tunic with yellow trim at the hem and sleeves. Over the tunic, the figure wears a blue-green cape with a yellow interior and zigzag edge that drapes over the left shoulder and down the back, almost reaching the feet. The figure also wears a yellow headband with a red section, adorned with three feathers—one red, one green, and one light blue—protruding vertically. The figure’s lower legs are covered in maroon leggings, with black shoes and yellow anklets. The figure holds a brown rectangular object, possibly a book or a box, clasped in both hands and held against the chest. An earring is present in the visible ear. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white in color. The artist’s name “Eugene Croe” is signed in purple ink in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cigar Store Indian
